Even if your direction is correct, your position will slowly lose value as if blood is being drawn. Response strategy: Always check the rate before opening a position and try to avoid high-rate periods; for short-term trading, get in and out quickly, don’t hold through the settlement cycle; only do the opposite operation of the paying side to steadily earn money.
Second, liquidation price—the warning line that is most “deceptive.” Don’t think that 10x leverage can withstand a 10% fluctuation! The liquidation price displayed by the platform already includes fees, slippage, margin, etc. As long as the price retraces by 5%, your position may just “vanish into thin air.” Solution: Use a light position with a per-position model, control the risk of each trade, and don’t go all in; reduce leverage, 3 - 5x leverage has a greater buffer space and is more stable; set your own stop-loss line, don’t wait for the platform to liquidate, protect your capital first.
Third, high leverage—seemingly enticing “get-rich trap.” 100x leverage sounds great, but fees and funding costs are calculated based on nominal capital, even if the direction is right, these costs may “eat away” at your capital. Response strategy: Use high leverage only for trial and error, do very short-term trading, and strictly manage stop-loss; low leverage is suitable for capturing trends, 3 - 5x leverage is more stable; take profits when they are available, don’t be too greedy, and put the money safely in your pocket.

哪怕分析得再精准，也可能在毫无征兆的瞬间被搅得一团糟。

利润看似稳定的时候死死守着，错过了最佳的止盈时机，没能果断离场。

定好目标，一旦达到就毫不犹豫地收手。

机会多得是，但你缺的不是努力，而是掌握稳定盈利的门道。
